invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null Iterator, either from a new JavaLazyInsertIterable or by delegation to super.
idPfx is a required argument for constructing file names; inferred to be non-null as used directly in constructors and super call.
recordItr is required for insertion; used to create JavaLazyInsertIterable and passed to super. Likely assumed non-null.
The returned value must always be an Iterator, as dictated by the method signature.
